label: Page effects
description: Whole-page effects: smooth scrolling, fades between pages, a grain overlay, a scroll progress bar and a custom cursor ring. Each one is off until you turn it on. Nothing shows in the editor, only on the live page.

fields.name: smoothScroll
fields.label: Smooth scrolling
fields.helpText: Applies to the whole page. Put this element anywhere on the page, once. Clicking an in-page link scrolls smoothly. Off for visitors who ask for reduced motion.

fields.name: pageTransition
fields.label: Fade between pages
fields.helpText: Applies to the whole page. Put this element anywhere on the page, once. Pages fade when a visitor moves between them. Browsers without view transitions change pages as usual.

fields.name: transitionMs
fields.label: Fade length (ms)
fields.helpText: How long the page fade takes, from 100 to 600 milliseconds. Used only when fades are on.

fields.name: grain
fields.label: Grain overlay
fields.helpText: Applies to the whole page. Put this element anywhere on the page, once. A fine film-grain texture over the page. Clicks pass through it.

fields.name: grainOpacity
fields.label: Grain strength (%)
fields.helpText: How strong the grain is, from 1% (faint) to 30% (heavy). Used only when the grain is on.

fields.name: scrollProgress
fields.label: Scroll progress bar
fields.helpText: Applies to the whole page. Put this element anywhere on the page, once. A thin bar across the top fills as the visitor scrolls. Browsers without scroll-linked animation show no bar.

fields.name: cursor
fields.label: Custom cursor
fields.helpText: Applies to the whole page. Put this element anywhere on the page, once. Live page only. A ring follows the pointer and grows over links and buttons. Not shown on touch screens or for visitors who ask for reduced motion.

fields.name: cursorSize
fields.label: Cursor size (px)
fields.helpText: Width of the cursor ring, from 16 to 80 pixels. Used only when a custom cursor is on.

fields.name: cursorColor
fields.label: Cursor colour
fields.helpText: The colour of the ring and dot. Used only when a custom cursor is on.

fields.name: cursorHideNative
fields.label: Hide the normal cursor
fields.helpText: Hides the normal arrow while the custom cursor is active. Leave off to keep both. Never applies on touch screens or with reduced motion.

fields.name: progressColor
fields.label: Progress bar colour
fields.helpText: The colour of the scroll progress bar. Used only when the bar is on.

fields.name: progressHeight
fields.label: Progress bar height (px)
fields.helpText: How thick the scroll progress bar is, from 1 to 8 pixels. Used only when the bar is on.

label: Pagination
description: Previous and next links with numbered pages, in a navigation landmark. Page links come from the link pattern.

fields.name: current
fields.label: Current page
fields.helpText: Clamped to the range 1 to the total.

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.label: Link pattern
fields.helpText: Use {page} where the page number goes, for example ?page={page} or /blog/page/{page}.
